CONCERNING
THE IMPLEMENTATION OF PROTECTION FOR WOMEN AND CHILDREN VICTIMS OF VIOLENCE

qa_issues: Meaning drift in legal citation: item 9 Supplement number translated as 3209 but original is 3209? (original: 3209) — actually original states 3209; however State Gazette supplement number appears inconsistent with typical format; translation should match original exactly: 'Nomor 3209' is correct but original says 3209; no change needed. Main issue: item 9 supplement number mistranslated: original 'Nomor 3209' but translation 'Number 3209' is fine. Real issue: item 5 omits the parenthetical English title 'Convention On The Elimination Of All Forms Of Discrimination Againts Women' present in original; translation dropped this content.
Meaning drift/omission: item 5 missing the parenthetical convention title as written in the original (including its spelling), which must be preserved in the translation output.

text:
DEWAN PERWAKILAN RAKYAT DAERAH KOTA TUAL
WALIKOTA TUAL
MEMUTUSKAN :
Menetapkan : PERATURAN DAERAH TENTANG PENYELENGGARAAN  PERLINDUNGAN PEREMPUAN DAN ANAK KORBAN  KEKERASAN.
translated_text:
REGIONAL HOUSE OF REPRESENTATIVES OF TUAL CITY
MAYOR OF TUAL
DECIDES :
To Establish : REGIONAL REGULATION CONCERNING THE IMPLEMENTATION OF PROTECTION FOR WOMEN AND CHILDREN VICTIMS OF VIOLENCE.

text:
BAB I
KETENTUAN UMUM
Pasal 1
Dalam Peraturan Daerah ini yang dimaksud dengan :
1. Daerah adalah Kota Tual.
2. Pemerintahan Daerah adalah penyelenggaraan urusan pemerintahan oleh  Pemerintah Daerah dan Dewan Perwakilan Rakyat Daerah menurut asas  otonomi dan Tugas Pembantuan dengan prinsip otonomi seluas-luasnya  dalam sistem dan prinsip Negara Kesatuan Republik Indonesia  sebagaimana dimaksud dalam Undang-Undang Dasar Negara Republik  Indonesia Tahun 1945.
3. Pemerintah Daerah adalah kepala daerah sebagai unsur penyelenggara  Pemerintahan Daerah yang memimpin pelaksanaan urusan  pemerintahan yang menjadi kewenangan daerah otonom.
4. Walikota adalah Walikota Tual.
5. Dewan Perwakilan Rakyat Daerah, yang selanjutnya disingkat DPRD  adalah lembaga perwakilan rakyat daerah sebagai unsur penyelenggara  Pemerintahan Daerah.
6. Penyelenggaraan adalah segala tindakan yang dilakukan oleh lembaga  pemerintah maupun non pemerintah yang meliputi pencegahan,  perlindungan dan pemulihan kepada korban kekerasan perempuan  dan anak.
7. Anak adalah seseorang yang belum berusia 18 (delapan belas) tahun, dan  belum kawin termasuk anak yang masih dalam kandungan.
8. Perempuan adalah setiap orang yang secara fisik dilahirkan  sebagai perempuan.
9. Korban adalah perempuan dan atau anak yang mengalami kesengsaraan  dan atau penderitaan baik langsung maupun tidak langsung sebagai  akibat dari suatu perbuatan kekerasan.
10. Pencegahan adalah segala upaya yang dilakukan oleh lembaga  pemerintah maupun non pemerintah yang ditujukan untuk memberikan  rasa aman kepada perempuan dan anak.
11. Perlindungan anak adalah segala kegiatan yang dilakukan untuk  menjamin dan melindungi anak dan hak-haknya agar dapat hidup,  tumbuh, berkembang dan berpartisipasi secara optimal sesuai dengan  harkat dan martabat kemanusiaan, serta mendapat perlindungan dari  kekerasan dan diskriminasi.
12. Perlindungan perempuan adalah segala kegiatan yang dilakukan untuk  menjamin dan melindungi anak dan hak-haknya agar dapt hidup,  tumbuh, berkembang dan berpartisipasi secara optimal sesuai dengan  harkat dan martabat kemanusiaan, serta mendapat perlindungan dari  kekerasan dan diskriminasi.
13. Kesengsaraan adalah setiap perbuatan yang berakibat atau dapat  mengakibatkan penderitaan baik psykis, fisik, seksual, ekonomi, sosial  terhadap korban.
14. Kekerasan Fisik adalah setiap perbuatan yang mengakibatkan rasa sakit,  cedera, luka atau cacat pada ubuh seseorang, gugurnya kandungan,  pingsang atau menyebabkan kematian.
15. Kekerasan psykis adalah perbuatan yang mengakibatkan ketakutan,  hilangnya rasa percaya diri, hilangnya kemampuan untuk bertindak, rasa  takut tidak berdaya, dan atau penderitaan psykis berat pada perempuan  dan atau anak.
16. Kekerasan seksual adalah setiap perbuatan berupa pelecehan seksual,  pemaksaan hubungan seksual dengan orang lain untuk tujuan komersial  dan atau tujuan tertentu.
17. Pelayanan adalah tindakan yang dilakukan sesegera mungkin kepada  korban, ketika melihat, mendengar dan mengetahui akan, sedang atau  setelah terjadinya kekerasan terhadap korban.
18. Pendamping adalah orang atau lembaga yang mempunyai kemampuan  melakukan pendampingan korban untuk melakukan konseling, terapi,  layanan hukum dan advokasi guna penguatan pemulihan korban.
19. Lembaga perlindungan perempuan dan anak adalah lembaga penyedia  layanan terhadap korban kekerasan, yang berbasis rumah sakit, dikelola  secara bersama-sama dalam bentuk pelayanan medis (Termasuk  Medicolegal), pisko-sosial dan pelayanan hukum.
20. Rumah aman adalah tempat tinggal sementara yang digunakan untuk  memberikan perlindungan terhadap perempuan dan anak korban sesuai  dengan standar operasional prosedur atau disingkat SOP yang  ditentukan.
21. Masyarakat adalah perseorangan, keluarga, kelompok, organisasi sosial  dan atau organisasi kemasyarakatan lain.
22. Pusat Pelayanan Terpadu yang selanjutnya disebut PPT suatu unit  kesatuan yang menyelenggarakan funsi pelayanan terpadu bagi  perempuan dan anak korban kekerasan, yang berbasis rumah sakit,  puskesmas, P2TP2A, Rumah Aman, Rumah Perlindungan Sosial Anak  (RPSA), Rumah Perlindungan Trauma Center (RPTC), Rumah  Perlindungan Sosial Wanita (RPSW).
23. Pusat Pelayanan Terpadu Pemberdayaan Perempuan dan Anak  selanjutnya disingkat P2TP2A adalah unit pelayanan terpadu yang  dibentuk oleh Pemerintah Daerah untuk memberikan pelayanan kepada  perempuan dan anak korban kekerasan secara konfrehensip dan  berkwalitas.
translated_text:
CHAPTER I
GENERAL PROVISIONS
Article 1
In this Regional Regulation what is meant by:
1. Region is the City of Tual.
2. Regional Government is the administration of governmental affairs by the Regional Government and the Regional House of Representatives according to the principles of autonomy and Co-Administration with the principle of the widest possible autonomy within the system and principles of the Unitary State of the Republic of Indonesia as referred to in the 1945 Constitution of the Republic of Indonesia.
3. Regional Government is the regional head as an element of the Regional Government administration who leads the implementation of governmental affairs that are the authority of the autonomous region.
4. Mayor is the Mayor of Tual.
5. Regional House of Representatives, hereinafter abbreviated as DPRD, is a regional people's representative institution as an element of the Regional Government administration.
6. Implementation is all actions carried out by government and non-government institutions which include prevention, protection and recovery for victims of violence against women and children.
7. Child is a person who has not yet reached the age of 18 (eighteen) years, and has not married including a child still in the womb.
8. Woman is every person who is physically born as a woman.
9. Victim is a woman and or child who experiences suffering and or hardship either directly or indirectly as a result of an act of violence.
10. Prevention is all efforts carried out by government and non-government institutions aimed at providing a sense of security to women and children.
11. Child protection is all activities carried out to guarantee and protect children and their rights so that they can live, grow, develop and participate optimally in accordance with human dignity and worth, and receive protection from violence and discrimination.
12. Women protection is all activities carried out to guarantee and protect women and their rights so that they can live, grow, develop and participate optimally in accordance with human dignity and worth, and receive protection from violence and discrimination.
13. Suffering is any act that results in or can result in suffering whether psychological, physical, sexual, economic, social to the victim.
14. Physical Violence is any act that causes pain, injury, wounds or disability to a person's body, miscarriage, fainting or causes death.
15. Psychological violence is an act that causes fear, loss of self-confidence, loss of ability to act, feelings of fear, helplessness, and or severe psychological suffering to women and or children.
16. Sexual violence is any act in the form of sexual harassment, forced sexual relations with others for commercial purposes and or certain purposes.
17. Service is action taken as soon as possible to the victim, when seeing, hearing and knowing before, during or after the occurrence of violence against the victim.
18. Companion is a person or institution that has the ability to provide assistance to victims to conduct counseling, therapy, legal services and advocacy for strengthening victim recovery.
19. Women and child protection institution is an institution providing services to victims of violence, based in hospitals, managed jointly in the form of medical services (Including Medicolegal), psycho-social and legal services.
20. Safe house is a temporary residence used to provide protection to women and children victims in accordance with the standard operating procedures or abbreviated as SOP that are determined.
21. Community is individuals, families, groups, social organizations and or other community organizations.
22. Integrated Service Center hereinafter referred to as PPT is a unified unit that organizes integrated service functions for women and children victims of violence, based in hospitals, community health centers, P2TP2A, Safe Houses, Child Social Protection Houses (RPSA), Trauma Center Protection Houses (RPTC), Women's Social Protection Houses (RPSW).
23. Integrated Service Center for Women and Child Empowerment hereinafter abbreviated as P2TP2A is an integrated service unit established by the Regional Government to provide services to women and children victims of violence in a comprehensive and quality manner.
qa_issues: Meaning drift in item 12: should define 'protection of women' but the translation repeats 'children and their rights' (should be 'women and their rights').

text:
Pasal 2
Tujuan penyelenggaraan perlindungan perempuan dan anak korban  kekerasan adalah bertujuan untuk memberikan pencegahan, perlindungan  dan pelayanan terhadap perempuan dan anak dari tindak kekerasan.
translated_text:
Article 2
The purpose of implementing protection for women and children victims of violence is to provide prevention, protection and services to women and children from acts of violence.

qa_issues: Meaning drift: internal cross-reference is incorrect/illogical; original refers to another article (likely Article 2), but translation repeats 'as referred to in article 3'.
Meaning drift/typo: "psylogis" refers to "psychological"; translation is fine but should reflect the original term "psychological" (spelling correction to standard English).
Meaning drift/grammar: paragraph (3) contains an erroneous extra word/phrase ('services for in the form of') that is not present in the original and makes the provision unclear.

Minor meaning/structure: item (2)(c) should refer to cooperation in the implementation/administration of protection for Women and Children from acts of violence (not 'implementation of protection of Women and Children' without 'protection' as the object).

text:
BAB IV
PENYELENGGARAAN PERLINDUNGAN
Bagian Kesatu
Kelembagaan
translated_text:
CHAPTER IV
IMPLEMENTATION OF PROTECTION
Part One
Institutional

text:
Pasal 9
(1) Dalam penyelenggaraan perlindungan terhadap perempuan dan anak  korban kekerasan yang meliputi kegiatan pencegahan dan  penanggulangan dibentuk Pusat Pelayanan Terpadu (PPT).
(2) PPT sebagaimana dimaksud pada ayat (1), terdiri dari unsur  Pemerintah Daerah dan unsur yang berasal dari lembaga terkait di luar  Pemerintah Daerah.
(3) Ketentuan lebih lanjut mengenai PPT sebagaimana dimaksud pada  ayat (1), akan diatur lebih lanjut dengan Peraturan Walikota.
(4) PPT sebagaimana dimaksud pada Ayat (1), dalam menyelenggarakan  perlindungan Perempuan dan anak korban kekerasan dapat melakukan  koordinasi dengan lembaga dan atau organisasi di Kota Tual.
(5) Dalam Penyelenggaraan Perlindungan terhadap perempuan dan anak  korban kekerasan dapat dibentuk di tingkat kecamatan, Kelurahan  dan Desa.
translated_text:
Article 9
(1) In the implementation of protection for women and children victims of violence, which includes prevention and handling activities, an Integrated Service Center (PPT) shall be established.
(2) The PPT as referred to in paragraph (1) consists of elements of the Regional Government and elements originating from related institutions outside the Regional Government.
(3) Further provisions regarding the PPT as referred to in paragraph (1) shall be further regulated by a Mayor's Regulation.
(4) The PPT as referred to in paragraph (1), in implementing protection for women and children victims of violence, may coordinate with institutions and/or organizations in Tual City.
(5) In the implementation of protection for women and children victims of violence, an Integrated Service Center may be formed at the sub-district, urban village, and village levels.
qa_issues: Meaning drift: 'penanggulangan' translated as 'mitigation' instead of 'handling/response' (countermeasures).
Meaning drift/grammar: paragraph (5) subject is unclear; original indicates a service/center may be formed at sub-district/kelurahan/desa levels (not 'it' referring to protection).
Meaning drift: 'Peraturan Walikota' should be 'Mayor Regulation'/'Mayor's Regulation' (not 'Mayor Regulation' as a generic phrase); clarify as a regulation issued by the Mayor.

text:
Pasal 10
(1) Selain membentuk PPT sebagaimana dimaksud dalam Pasal 9, untuk  menunjang terlaksananya pemberdayaan dan perlindungan terhadap  perempuan dan anak korban tindak kekerasan, pemerintah daerah dapat  membentuk P2TP2A.
(2) P2TP2A sebagaimana dimaksud pada ayat (1), terdiri dari unsur  Kepolisian, Kejaksaan, Pengadilan, Dinas Kesehatan, Dinas Sosial,  Kementrian Agama, Dinas Pemberdayaan Perempuan dan Perlindungan  Anak, LSM, Pemerhati Anak.
(3) P2TP2A sebagaimana dimaksud pada ayat (1), adalah unit kerja  fungsional mempunyai tugas menyelenggarakan pelayanan terpadu  perempuan dan anak korban kekerasan.
(4) Dalam melaksanakan tugas pokok dan fungsi sebagaimana dimaksud  pada ayat (3), P2TP2A dapat berkoordinasi dan menjadi mitra kerja PPT.  (5) Ketentuan lebih lanjut mengenai P2TP2A sebagaimana dimaksud pada  ayat (1), ayat (2), ayat (3), dan ayat (4), diatur dengan Peraturan Walikota.
translated_text:
Article 10
(1) In addition to establishing PPT as referred to in Article 9, to support the implementation of empowerment and protection of women and children victims of violence, the regional government may establish P2TP2A.
(2) P2TP2A as referred to in paragraph (1), consists of elements from the Police, Prosecutor's Office, Court, Health Office, Social Office, Ministry of Religious Affairs, Office of Women's Empowerment and Child Protection, NGOs, Child Observers.
(3) P2TP2A as referred to in paragraph (1), is a functional work unit having the duty to organize integrated services for women and children victims of violence.
(4) In carrying out the main duties and functions as referred to in paragraph (3), P2TP2A may coordinate and become a working partner of PPT.
(5) Further provisions regarding P2TP2A as referred to in paragraph (1), paragraph (2), paragraph (3), and paragraph (4), shall be regulated by the Mayor's Regulation.
qa_issues: Meaning drift/unnatural legal term: "Mayor Regulation" should be "Mayor's Regulation" (Peraturan Walikota).

text:
Bagian Kedua
Penanganan dan Mekanisme
translated_text:
Second Part
Handling and Mechanism

text:
Pasal 11
(1) Penyelenggaraan Perlindungan kepada korban dilaksanakan secara  terpadu dalam penanganan medis, perlindungan hukum, medicolegal,  psikologis maupun ekonomi yang pelaksanaanya dapat dilakukan melalui  kemitraan dengan lembaga-lembaga sosial kemasyarakatan yang  bergerak dalam bidang perlindungan perempuan dan anak.
(2) Penyelenggaraan perlindungan kepada korban sebagaimana dimaksud  pada ayat (1), harus memeperhatikan norma-norma agama serta hak dan  kewajiban orang tua, wali, suami atau orang lain yang secara hukum  bertanggungjawab terhadap korban.
(3) Prinsip pelayanan dan pendampingan :
c. cepat, aman dan empati;
d. adanya jaminan kerahasiaan;
e. mudah dijangkau; dan
f. tidak dipungut biaya.
(4) Mekanisme penanganan perlindungan sebagaimana dimaksud ayat (1),  dilksanakan sesuai standar operasional prosedur.
translated_text:
Article 11
(1) The implementation of Protection for victims is carried out in an integrated manner in medical treatment, legal protection, medicolegal, psychological and economic aspects, the implementation of which can be conducted through partnerships with social community institutions engaged in the protection of women and children.
(2) The implementation of protection for victims as referred to in paragraph (1), must take into account religious norms as well as the rights and obligations of parents, guardians, husbands or other persons who are legally responsible for the victim.
(3) Principles of service and assistance:
c. fast, safe and empathetic;
d. guarantee of confidentiality;
e. easily accessible; and
f. no fees charged.
(4) The mechanism for handling protection as referred to in paragraph (1), is implemented in accordance with standard operating procedures.

text:
BAB V
BENTUK KEKERASAN DAN PERLINDUNGAN
Pasal 12
(1) Bentuk kekerasan terhadap perempuan dan anak meliputi fisik, psykis,  seksual, penelantaran, eksploitasi dan kekerasan lainya.
(2) Bentuk kekerasan fisik berupa setiap perbuatan yang mengakibatkan  rasa sakit, cedera, luka atau cacat pada tubuh seseorang, gugurnya janin  dalam kandungan dan atau menyebabkan kematian.
(3) Bentuk kekerasan seksual berupa pelecehan seksual, pemaksaan  hubungan seksual, pemaksaan hubungan seksual dengan tidak wajar  atau tidak disukai, pemaksaan hubungan seksual dengan orang lain  untuk tujuan komersial atau tujuan tertentu.
(4) Bentuk kekerasan psykis berupa perbuatan yang mengakibatkan  ketakutan, hilangnya rasa percaya diri, hilangnya kemampuan untuk  bertindak, rasa tidak berdaya.
(5) Bentuk kekerasan penelantaran berupa tindakan sengaja atau tidak  sengaja yang mengakibatkan tidak terpenuhinya kebutuhan dasar.  (6) Bentuk kekerasan eksploitasi adalah bentuk kekerasan meliputi  tindakan mengeksploitasi ekonomi atau seksual anak untuk  menguntungkan diri sendiri atau orang lain, tindakan dengan atau tanpa  persetujuan korban tapi tidak terbatas pada pelacuran, kerja atau pelayanan paksa, perbudakan atau praktik serupa, penindasan,  pemerasan, pemanfaatan fisik, seksual, organ reproduksi, atau secara  melawan hukum,memindahkan atau mentrasplantasi organ dan atau  jaringan tubuh atau memanfaatkan atau kemampuan seseorang untuk  mendapatkan keuntungan.
translated_text:
CHAPTER V
FORMS OF VIOLENCE AND PROTECTION
Article 12
(1) Forms of violence against women and children include physical, psychological, sexual, neglect, exploitation and other violence.
(2) Forms of physical violence are any acts that result in pain, injury, wounds or disability to a person's body, miscarriage of a fetus in the womb and/or cause death.
(3) Forms of sexual violence are sexual harassment, forced sexual intercourse, forced sexual intercourse in an unnatural or unwanted manner, forced sexual intercourse with other persons for commercial purposes or certain purposes.
(4) Forms of psychological violence are acts that result in fear, loss of self-confidence, loss of ability to act, and feelings of helplessness.
(5) Forms of violence through neglect are intentional or unintentional actions that result in the non-fulfillment of basic needs.
(6) Forms of violence through exploitation are forms of violence including acts of exploiting children economically or sexually to benefit oneself or others, acts with or without the consent of the victim, but not limited to prostitution, forced labor or services, slavery or similar practices, oppression, extortion, exploitation of the physical body, sexual aspects, reproductive organs, or unlawfully transferring or transplanting organs and/or body tissues, or exploiting a person's abilities to obtain benefits.
qa_issues: Meaning drift/awkward rendering in (6): "utilizing or the ability of a person" is ungrammatical and does not clearly convey "memanfaatkan ... kemampuan seseorang" (exploiting a person's abilities)
Minor meaning/term issue: "psyikis" should be rendered as "psychic/psychological" consistently; (1) uses "psychological" but original lists "psykis"—keep consistent and accurate

text:
Pasal 13
(1) Setiap perempuan dan anak yang menjadi korban kekerasan harus  mendapat perlindungan sesuai ketentuan yang berlaku.
(2) Perlindungan terhadap perempuan dan anak korban kekerasan  sebagaimana dimaksud pada ayat (1) dilakukan terhadap penduduk  Kota Tual baik di Kota Tual maupun di luar Kota Tual.
translated_text:
Article 13
(1) Every woman and child who becomes a victim of violence must receive protection in accordance with applicable provisions.
(2) Protection of women and children victims of violence as referred to in paragraph (1) shall be provided to residents of Tual City both in Tual City and outside Tual City.

text:
Pasal 14
(1) Bentuk perlindungan terhadap perempuan dan anak korban kekerasan  berupa perlindungan medis, hukum, medicolegal ( kedokteran forensik ) ,  psikologis, pemulangan dan reintegrasi social.
(2) Bentuk perlindungan medis terhadap Perempuan dan anak korban  kekerasan sebagaimana dimaksud pada ayat (1). Berupa perawatan dan  pemulihan luka – luka fisik yang bertujuan untuk pemulihan kondisi  fisik korban yang dilakukan oleh tenaga medis dan para medis.
(3) Bentuk perlindungan hukum terhadap perempuan dan anak korban  kekerasan sebagaimana dimaksud pada ayat ( 1 ), berupa pelayanan dan  pendampingan untuk membantu korban dalam menjalani proses hukum  dan peradilan.
(4) Bentuk perlindungan medicolegal terhadap perempuan dan anak korban  kekerasan sebagaimana dimaksud pada ayat (1) berupa layanan medis  untuk kepentingan pembuktian di bidang hokum.
(5) Bentuk perlindungan psykologis terhadap perempuan dan anak korban  kekerasan sebagaimana dimaksud pada ayat (1), berupa pendampingan  dalam rangka pemulihan kondisi traumatis korban termasuk penyediaan  Rumah Aman untuk melindungi korban dari berbagai ancaman dan  intimidasi bagi korban dan memberikan dukungan secara psykologis  sehingga korban mempunyai rasa percaya diri, kekuatan dan  kemandirian dalam penyelesaian masalah.
(6) Bentuk perlindungan Pemulangan sebagaimana dimaksud pada ayat(1)  adalah upaya untuk mengembalikan perempuan dan anak korban  kekerasan dari luar negeri ke titik deberkasi/entry point, atau dari  daerah penerima ke daeah asal.
(7) Bentuk perlindungan Reintegrasi Sosial sebagaimana dimaksud pada  ayat (1) adalah upaya penyatuan kembali perempuan dan anak korban  kekerasan dengan pihak keluarga, keluarga pengganti.
translated_text:
Article 14
(1) Forms of protection for women and children victims of violence consist of medical, legal, medicolegal (forensic medicine), psychological protection, repatriation and social reintegration.
(2) Forms of medical protection for women and children victims of violence as referred to in paragraph (1), in the form of treatment and recovery of physical injuries aimed at restoring the physical condition of victims carried out by medical personnel and paramedics.
(3) Forms of legal protection for women and children victims of violence as referred to in paragraph (1), in the form of services and assistance to help victims undergo legal and judicial processes.
(4) Forms of medicolegal protection for women and children victims of violence as referred to in paragraph (1) in the form of medical services for the purposes of evidence in the legal field.
(5) Forms of psychological protection for women and children victims of violence as referred to in paragraph (1), in the form of assistance in the context of recovery from traumatic conditions of victims including provision of Safe Houses to protect victims from various threats and intimidation for victims and provide psychological support so that victims have self-confidence, strength and independence in resolving problems.
(6) Forms of Repatriation protection as referred to in paragraph (1) is an effort to return women and children victims of violence from abroad to the debarkation point/entry point, or from the receiving area to the area of origin.
(7) Forms of Social Reintegration protection as referred to in paragraph (1) is an effort to reunite women and children victims of violence with the family party, and substitute family.
qa_issues: Meaning drift/grammar: paragraph (2) incorrectly split into two sentences; should be a single clause ('...as referred to in paragraph (1), in the form of...') to match the original structure.

Meaning drift: paragraph (7) omits 'the party' (pihak) before family; should indicate reunification with the family party and substitute family. Also needs conjunction 'and' before 'substitute family'.

text:
BAB VI
PERAN SERTA MASYARAKAT
Pasal 15
(1) Pemerintah dalam menyelenggarakan perlindungan perempuan dan anak  korban kekerasan. Dapat melibatkan peran serta masyarakat.  (2) Peran serta sebagaimana dimaksud pada ayat (1), dapat dilakukan oleh  perorangn, kelompok maupun organisasi sosial kemasyarakatan.
translated_text:
CHAPTER VI
COMMUNITY PARTICIPATION
Article 15
(1) The Government in implementing protection for women and children victims of violence may involve community participation.
(2) Participation as referred to in paragraph (1), may be carried out by individuals, groups or social community organizations.

text:
Pasal 16
(1) Organisasi Sosial kemasyarakatan yang berperan serta dalam  penyelenggaraan perlindungan perempuan dan anak korban kekerasan  sebagaimana dimaksud pada pasal 15 ayat (2), diberikan pembinaan oleh  pemerintah daerah melalui organisasi perangkat daerah yang terkait  dengan tugas Pemberdayaan Perempuan dan Perlindungan Anak.
(2) Pembinaan organisasi sebagaimana dimaksud pada ayat (1), dapat  berupa bmbingan sosial, bimbingan ketrampilan dan bimbingan  teknis operasional.
translated_text:
Article 16
(1) Social community organizations that participate in the implementation of protection for women and children victims of violence as referred to in Article 15 paragraph (2) shall be provided guidance by the regional government through the relevant regional apparatus organizations tasked with Women's Empowerment and Child Protection.
(2) Organizational guidance as referred to in paragraph (1) may be in the form of social guidance, skills guidance, and operational technical guidance.

translated_text:
CHAPTER VIII
SOURCES OF FUNDS AND REPORTING
Article 19
(1) The source of funds for the implementation of protection for women and children victims of violence, carried out by the regional apparatus of Tual City, shall be from the Regional Revenue and Expenditure Budget of Tual City.
(2) The source of funds as referred to in paragraph (1) may also come from other lawful and non-binding sources.
(3) The source of funds for implementation from other lawful sources as referred to in paragraph (2) shall be subject to supervision in accordance with the provisions of laws and regulations.
(4) PPT is obligated to report the implementation of the provision of protection for women and children victims of violence periodically to the Mayor of Tual in accordance with applicable regulations.
qa_issues: Meaning drift/ambiguity in paragraph (1): 'violence carried out by the regional apparatus' should modify the implementation/organizing of protection (by the regional apparatus), not the violence.
Meaning drift in paragraph (2): 'other legal and non-binding sources' should be 'other lawful and non-binding sources' (sumber-sumber lain yang sah dan tidak mengikat).

text:
I. UMUM
Penyelenggaraan perlindungan terhadap korban kekerasan  diselenggarakan berdasarkan pada prinsip kemanusiaan, keterpaduan  dan keadilan. Sehingga setiap orang harus mendapatkan haknya atas  perlindungan terhadap rasa aman serta terbebas dari penyiksaan atau  perlakuan yang merendahkan derajat martabat manusia yang  bertentangan dengan apa yang dicita-citakan dalam Pembukaan Undang Undang Dasar Negara Republik Indonesia Tahun 1945 yaitu terciptanya  kemanusiaan yang adil dan beradab. Secara prinsip, sasaran strategis  penyelenggaraan perlindungan adalah menjaga keberlanjutan  perlindungan melalui upaya layanan terpadu, komperhensif dan rumah  aman dan nyaman yang kondusif untuk korban kekerasan. Sasaran  strategis tersebut ditempuh melalui tahapantahapan yang saling terkait,  baik perencanaan, perlindungan, layanan dan pembiayaan, pengawasan  serta sanksi.
Oleh karena itu, diperlukan payung hukum berupa Peraturan  Daerah yang mampu mengakomodir semua isu terkait penyelenggaraan  perlindungan terhadap perempuan dan anak korban kekerasan, mampu  memberikan layanan terpadu secara holistik dan komprehensif, dan  secara tegas memberikan mandat kepada lembaga untuk melakukan  koordinasi kebijakan dan pengawasan, dan mandat kepada lembaga  untuk memberikan layanan. Selain itu, peraturan daerah juga dapat  membuka keterlibatan institusi non pemerintah dan masyarakat untuk  berperan secara luas.
Berdasarkan beberapa pertimbangan diatas, maka perlu  membentuk Peraturan Daerah tentang Penyelenggaraan Perlindungan  Perempuan dan Anak Korban Kekerasan.
translated_text:
I. GENERAL
The implementation of protection for victims of violence is conducted based on the principles of humanity, integration and justice. Therefore, every person must obtain their right to protection for a sense of security and freedom from torture or treatment that degrades human dignity which contradicts what is aspired to in the Preamble of the 1945 Constitution of the Republic of Indonesia, namely the creation of just and civilized humanity. In principle, the strategic target of implementing protection is to maintain the sustainability of protection through integrated, comprehensive services and safe and comfortable shelters that are conducive for victims of violence. These strategic targets are pursued through interrelated stages, including planning, protection, services and financing, supervision and sanctions.
Therefore, a legal umbrella in the form of a Regional Regulation is needed that is capable of accommodating all issues related to the implementation of protection for women and children victims of violence, capable of providing holistic and comprehensive integrated services, and explicitly providing a mandate to institutions to carry out policy coordination and supervision, and a mandate to institutions to provide services. In addition, regional regulations can also open the involvement of non-governmental institutions and the community to play a broad role.
Based on several considerations above, it is necessary to establish a Regional Regulation on the Implementation of Protection for Women and Children Victims of Violence.
